scope: Matched 50k asset-backed configured-root startup-only comparison, one run per binary.
interpretation: The current run was faster on this specific startup-only fixture. With one run per candidate and many source differences, this is descriptive only and does not isolate the cause or establish a general performance improvement.
limitations: n=1 per candidate; no p95, variance estimate, or performance promotion.
Startup-only workload did not time page reads or projection readiness.
The 20-second registration allowance is distinct from full startup wait; neither run timed out.

An earlier attempt failed during synthetic fixture seeding due to temporary quota before the app started; a retry correctly refused a stale binary before launch. Neither is an app startup measurement.

The historical baseline profile archive was first rejected because an internal hardlink target was omitted; the source profile remained intact. The corrected archive verified all 744 regular-file hashes and made 50,000 identical synthetic WAV hardlinks reconstructible from a verified master before the temporary profile was removed.
The comparison does not establish causality across the code changes or broader startup, page, user-library, development/release, or whole-app performance.
